title: One Spot in Venezuela Gets 1.2 Million Lightning Bolts a Year

scenes.text: One spot in Venezuela gets 1.2 million lightning bolts a year.
It's the mouth of the Catatumbo River, and storms flash there about 10 hours a night.
That happens on roughly 140 to 160 nights every year.
Guinness World Records gave it the title for the highest concentration of lightning on Earth.
The storms are so far from observers that you rarely hear thunder.
Lightning on repeat, in the same place, night after night.
